resources.string: When this is on, allowed live items appear at the camera hole. Turn this off to remove the pill and the notice.
Skerry draws a small pill at the camera hole. Allow the overlay permission and the pill can sit on top of the launcher. Skerry does not use an Accessibility service.
Skerry reads notifications only from apps you turn on, and only while the island is on. It does not use an Accessibility service.
Notification access is off, so the pill stays hidden.
Overlay permission is off, so the pill stays hidden.
When this is on, plugging in adds a charging item to the pill. It is not an app.
Unrestricted battery use makes it harder for the phone to freeze the pill. Skerry does not turn this on by itself.
Only apps you turn on can appear on the pill. With none turned on, Skerry shows nothing.
Shown while the island is on
The pill is at the camera hole.
